study_identification_part.si4_title: Normative modeling of brain MRI data identifies small subcortical volumes and associations with cognitive function in youth with fetal alcohol spectrum disorder (FASD)

cm1_research_objectives.reason: Hypotheses and goals are clearly stated in the abstract and introduction. The study aims to quantify subcortical anomalies in FASD, evaluate relative sensitivity/specificity versus controls, and examine associations with cognitive function. The purpose of normative modeling is described as using brain growth charts to characterize individual-level anomalies adjusted for age, sex, and ICV.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: "Aim: To quantify regional subcortical brain volume anomalies ... assess the relative sensitivity and specificity ... and examine associations with cognitive function."; "In the current study, we extend this approach by examining regional subcortical volume anomalies ... we calculated z-scores adjusted for age, sex, and total intracranial volume (ICV)."
